```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(multcomp)
library(gridExtra)
library(cowplot)
```

## 项目概述

本报告用于复现一篇土壤生物与生物地球化学相关论文中的部分图表。

### 复现内容

- **图 1**：土壤有机碳组分箱线图
- **图 2**：土壤有机碳分子的旋转主成分分析（PCA）双图
- **扩展数据图 ED2**：土壤与植物生物地球化学特征箱线图
- **扩展数据图 ED4**：不同植被类型与火干扰下的碳组分差异箱线图
- **扩展数据图 ED5**：土壤有机碳分子组分相关性热图

## 项目环境

```{r}
sessionInfo()
```

## 图 1：土壤有机碳组分箱线图

使用 ggplot2 绘制土壤有机碳官能团与分子类别的箱线图，展示不同碳组分的相对丰度分布。

```{r fig1, fig.cap="土壤有机碳组分箱线图", fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# 加载数据
data <- read.csv(here("data/raw/Hall_Ye_etal_NEON_NMR_biogeo.csv"), header = TRUE)

# 准备碳组分数据
test <- c(data$Carbohydrate_fraction, data$Protein_fraction, data$Lignin_fraction,
          data$Lipid_fraction, data$Char_fraction, data$Carbonyl_fraction)

trts <- c(rep("Carbohydrate", nrow(data)), rep("Protein", nrow(data)),
          rep("Lignin", nrow(data)), rep("Lipid", nrow(data)),
          rep("Char", nrow(data)), rep("Carbonyl", nrow(data)))
trts <- as.factor(trts)
SOM <- data.frame(test, trts)

# 绘制箱线图
p1 <- ggplot(SOM, aes(x = trts, y = test, fill = trts)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(x = "Carbon Group", y = "Relative Abundance") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

print(p1)
```

## 图 2：PCA 排序图

使用主成分分析展示土壤碳组分与主成分的关系。

```{r fig2, fig.cap="土壤有机碳分子 PCA 排序图", fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
# 准备 PCA 数据
pca_data <- data[, c("Carbohydrate_fraction", "Protein_fraction", "Lignin_fraction",
                      "Lipid_fraction", "Char_fraction", "Carbonyl_fraction")]

# 执行 PCA
pca_result <- prcomp(pca_data, scale. = TRUE)

# 绘制 PCA 双图
biplot(pca_result, main = "PCA Biplot of Soil Organic Carbon Components",
       cex = 0.8, col = c("black", "red"))
```

## 扩展数据图 ED2：环境因子分布箱线图

使用 ggplot2 绘制关键环境变量的分布。

```{r fig_ed2, fig.cap="环境因子分布箱线图", fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# 选择环境因子列（使用实际存在的列名）
env_cols <- c("phH2o", "carbonTot_g_kg", "nitrogenTot_g_kg", "OC_N_ratio",
              "sandTotal_percent", "siltTotal_percent", "clayTotal_percent",
              "MAP_mm", "MAT_C")

# 转换为长格式
env_data <- data[, env_cols]
env_long <- reshape(env_data, direction = "long",
                    varying = names(env_data),
                    v.names = "Value", timevar = "Variable",
                    times = names(env_data))

# 绘制分面箱线图
p2 <- ggplot(env_long, aes(x = Variable, y = Value)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~Variable, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p2)
```

## 扩展数据图 ED4：碳组分与环境因子关系图

```{r fig_ed4, fig.cap="不同植被类型下的碳组分差异", fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# 绘制植被类型与碳组分关系图
p3 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = NLCD_class, y = Carbohydrate_fraction, fill = NLCD_class)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
  labs(x = "Vegetation Type", y = "Carbohydrate Fraction") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

print(p3)
```

## 扩展数据图 ED5：有机碳分子组分相关性热图

```{r fig_ed5, fig.cap="土壤有机碳分子组分相关性热图", fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
# 选择碳组分列
carbon_cols <- c("Carbohydrate_fraction", "Protein_fraction", "Lignin_fraction",
                 "Lipid_fraction", "Char_fraction", "Carbonyl_fraction")

# 计算相关矩阵
cor_matrix <- cor(data[, carbon_cols], use = "complete.obs")

# 绘制热图
heatmap(cor_matrix, main = "Correlation Heatmap of Carbon Components",
        col = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(20),
        scale = "none", margins = c(10, 10))
```
